title: Unified Format
description: Unified Format is a comparison ability in the Unified & Side-by-Side Diffs database. Renders diffs in unified format with context lines. Changes show with 3 lines of context; headers name the files. It takes diffs and produces unified. Tunable parameters: 3 ctx. Guarantee: context never misaligns.

fields.mechanism: Changes show with 3 lines of context; headers name the files.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Side-by-Side
description: Side-by-Side is a comparison ability in the Unified & Side-by-Side Diffs database. Renders old and new side by side for easy scanning. Lines align pairwise; changed lines highlight in both panes. It takes diffs and produces two panes. Tunable parameters: aligned. Guarantee: alignment never drifts.

fields.mechanism: Lines align pairwise; changed lines highlight in both panes.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Word Diffs
description: Word Diffs is a comparison ability in the Unified & Side-by-Side Diffs database. Highlights changed words within changed lines. Changed lines diff at the word level; only the words highlight. It takes lines and produces word marks. Tunable parameters: per line. Guarantee: unchanged words never highlight.

fields.mechanism: Changed lines diff at the word level; only the words highlight.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Moved Code
description: Moved Code is a comparison ability in the Unified & Side-by-Side Diffs database. Detects code that moved rather than changed. Identical blocks at new positions render as moves, not add+delete. It takes diffs and produces moves. Tunable parameters: per block. Guarantee: moves are never mislabeled as edits.

fields.mechanism: Identical blocks at new positions render as moves, not add+delete.
fields.guarantees: moves are never mislabeled as edits

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Syntax-Aware Diffs
description: Syntax-Aware Diffs is a comparison ability in the Unified & Side-by-Side Diffs database. Diffs code by syntax tree, ignoring formatting. ASTs compare; pure formatting changes produce empty diffs. It takes code and produces diff. Tunable parameters: AST. Guarantee: formatting never shows as change.

fields.mechanism: ASTs compare; pure formatting changes produce empty diffs.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Image Diffs
description: Image Diffs is a comparison ability in the Unified & Side-by-Side Diffs database. Diffs images with blink and overlay modes. Pixels compare; differences blink or overlay in red. It takes images and produces diff view. Tunable parameters: per pixel. Guarantee: identical images always show clean.

fields.mechanism: Pixels compare; differences blink or overlay in red.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Binary Diffs
description: Binary Diffs is a comparison ability in the Unified & Side-by-Side Diffs database. Diffs binary files by bytes with offsets. Byte runs compare; differing ranges list with offsets. It takes binaries and produces byte diff. Tunable parameters: per range. Guarantee: offsets are always exact.

fields.mechanism: Byte runs compare; differing ranges list with offsets.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Three-Way View
description: Three-Way View is a comparison ability in the Unified & Side-by-Side Diffs database. Shows base, theirs, and yours for merges. All three panes align; conflicts highlight. It takes merges and produces 3 panes. Tunable parameters: aligned. Guarantee: the base is always visible.

fields.mechanism: All three panes align; conflicts highlight.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Hunk Navigation
description: Hunk Navigation is a comparison ability in the Unified & Side-by-Side Diffs database. Jumps between change hunks with keyboard shortcuts. Hunks list in order; next/prev keys move through them. It takes diffs and produces navigation. Tunable parameters: per hunk. Guarantee: navigation never skips a hunk.

fields.mechanism: Hunks list in order; next/prev keys move through them.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Collapse Unchanged
description: Collapse Unchanged is a comparison ability in the Unified & Side-by-Side Diffs database. Collapses long unchanged regions to one line. Regions over 10 lines fold; expanding shows them. It takes diffs and produces folded. Tunable parameters: 10+ lines. Guarantee: changed lines are never folded.

fields.mechanism: Regions over 10 lines fold; expanding shows them.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Diff Statistics
description: Diff Statistics is a comparison ability in the Unified & Side-by-Side Diffs database. Summarizes the diff — files, lines, plus/minus. Counts aggregate per file and total; the summary tops the diff. It takes diffs and produces stats. Tunable parameters: per file. Guarantee: stats always match the hunks.

fields.mechanism: Counts aggregate per file and total; the summary tops the diff.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Comment on Lines
description: Comment on Lines is a comparison ability in the Unified & Side-by-Side Diffs database. Lets reviewers comment on exact diff lines. Comments anchor to line and version; outdated comments mark. It takes diffs and produces threads. Tunable parameters: per line. Guarantee: comments never detach silently.

fields.mechanism: Comments anchor to line and version; outdated comments mark.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Suggest Changes
description: Suggest Changes is a comparison ability in the Unified & Side-by-Side Diffs database. Lets reviewers suggest exact replacement text. Suggestions are diffs on the diff; authors apply with one click. It takes reviews and produces suggestions. Tunable parameters: per hunk. Guarantee: suggestions always apply cleanly or not at all.

fields.mechanism: Suggestions are diffs on the diff; authors apply with one click.
fields.guarantees: suggestions always apply cleanly or not at all

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Ignore Whitespace
description: Ignore Whitespace is a comparison ability in the Unified & Side-by-Side Diffs database. Toggles whitespace-insensitive diffing. Whitespace-only changes hide; the toggle is per view. It takes diffs and produces cleaner. Tunable parameters: toggle. Guarantee: the toggle never alters the files.

fields.mechanism: Whitespace-only changes hide; the toggle is per view.
fields.guarantees: the toggle never alters the files

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Export Patches
description: Export Patches is a comparison ability in the Unified & Side-by-Side Diffs database. Exports any diff as an applicable patch file. Patches use unified format with paths; they apply with standard tools. It takes diffs and produces patch. Tunable parameters: unified. Guarantee: patches always apply to the same base.

fields.mechanism: Patches use unified format with paths; they apply with standard tools.
fields.guarantees: patches always apply to the same base

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.
